glosses: in the evening, at night, see Abend;
p.m., indicating that a time is in the evening or early night. a.m./p.m. have no direct equivalents in German; the appropriate time of day is used instead.

examples.en: What do you do in the evenings?
I'll call you in the evening.

examples.text: Bist du abends immer zu Hause?
examples.en: Are you always at home in the evening?

examples.text: Ich gehe abends spät ins Bett.
examples.en: I go to bed late at night.
We arrived here in the evening.
